fixture.transcription: Deterministic text returned by the decoder callback based on each fixture source and partial/final state.
fixture.owned_capture: Fixture runtime primes capture ownership and supplies packets and end event without starting native devices.

checked: The production drain and utterance queue consume both source tails in bounded queues. System audio starts earlier and sorts before microphone despite the final drain order.
Each final revises its matching partial in place, preserves source and offset, carries the fixture label and advances the context revision once.

Stop retains the recording until the last final transcript has been applied and capture ends. The file-backed store saves one stopped meeting and reopens with exactly the two finalized rows and matching metadata.
limits: ASR and the capture producer are fixtures. The check covers product queues, event handling and database persistence.
Live device permissions and shutdown, drift, echo, ASR quality, product traffic and matched reference workflows remain open.
